entry.name: AI Governance Professional (AIGP)
entry.note: The vendor-neutral AI governance credential; the governance counterpart to CIPP

covers: Foundational knowledge of AI systems and their use cases
Current and emerging laws applying to AI systems
Context in which AI risks are managed
reading.format: Certification exam; preparation uses the body of knowledge and exam blueprint.
reading.summary: The AIGP credential demonstrates competency in AI development, ethical AI deployment, and best practices in AI management to ensure safety and trust. Holding it shows an ability to execute responsible AI governance.
reading.audience: Professionals in all industries who need to understand and execute responsible AI governance.
